title: Use punctuation correctly

body.text: The voice sounds much more natural when the text has
. Periods, commas, and line breaks help the AI pace correctly. A long sentence with no commas sounds rushed — add periods/commas to control the pacing.

example: Instead of 'Hi everyone today we're learning about voice' use 'Hi everyone, today we're learning about voice.'
